findings.text: Both committed direction-reversal arms record converged=false (upper: 7 trips, 40.2382 mm; elongation: 4 trips, 112.6220 mm), while the controlled arms record converged=true. The finalizer rejects only when control_error <= arm_error at lines 1299-1305 and 1549-1553. A larger error from an unsettled state can be caused by incomplete fixed-point convergence rather than reversal of the active-current direction, so the report and evidence fragment cannot yet call this a causal discriminating control. Require a converged reversed-update equilibrium, or record and justify an explicit terminal residual criterion that makes the non-converged states comparable, before landing the control claim.

The regularisation guard checks only that each curve has eight rows; it never asserts that the row weights equal DELTA_REGULARISATION_WEIGHTS in order, nor that closure and current values are finite. The current persisted receipt is correct and was independently checked, but a duplicated or substituted eight-row sweep would still finalize and be captioned as the declared eight-weight grid.

The fixed negative label offset places both purple 'upper' direct labels below their low final points; in the persisted 1400-pixel regularisation figure the labels cross the bottom spine and are partly clipped below the axes. Offset low endpoint labels upward or expand the lower plotting margin so every coloured series name is wholly readable.

The tests field records prose summaries rather than the literal commands that ran, and all three gate-log headers abbreviate PYTHONPATH as <tree> instead of the required absolute path; the finalization log also contains an earlier EXIT=1 followed by the successful arm. Preserve literal replayable commands and one complete run per gate log.

The reviewed commits f58e3baa9 and b3cc1728e are reachable from the candidate head but neither is an ancestor of review base e47e3eab; coordinator integration must land both commits, not only the evidence tip.
